g.text: A tick is one axis pair in one neutral control family; the bar is the largest of them.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #9aa1ab

g.text: The two families are kept apart, never averaged: a scorer whose drift depends on the

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #9aa1ab

g.text: register of the text around an identity term is a reportable finding of its own.

g.text: FIXTURE DATA — synthetic rows so the figure renders and is tested; the confirmatory run (P11) drops real numbers through this same code.
